review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Define monitoring KPIs, telemetry, and synthetic tests; maintain runbooks and topology diagrams. What You’ll Need Minimum 5 years of experience in network engineering experience (enterprise/DC).
eligibility_evidence: Implement SD-WAN, remote access, and hybrid connectivity (IPSec/SSL, MPLS, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect).
Ability to work shifts/on-call; comfort working on-site in high-security environments.
Bonus Points If You Have Eligible for Top Secret Security Clearance or currently holds Top Secret Security Clearance status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The value for our clients and our people For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world. You combine deep platform expertise with automation to deliver predictable results at scale in regulated environments. What You’ll Need Minimum 5 years of experience in network engineering experience (enterprise/DC). Expertise with routing/switching, NGFW, VPN, load balancing, DNS/DHCP/IPAM.
